sermon.title: God’s Words to the Gentiles
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer teaches from Isaiah 34 and Revelation 6 about God’s dealing with the Gentiles: the ungodly and secular humanists. He argues that the stars falling and the sun darkening are not allegory, that Esau and the ten virgins show a door that closes, and that God’s purpose in judgment is to win the nations to Christ. He closes with two family stories to show how far parents go for their children, and says God wants even his opponents to live.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: he refers by name to several real, living public figures (a technology billionaire, an investor, and a television host) and to the Secular Student Alliance and the American Humanist Association; the names stay in the transcript only. The captions give “Billy Gates” and render one television host’s name inconsistently, so the first mention is marked “[unclear]”. He gives “Hebrews 12:6” for the Esau passage (Hebrews 12:16), and “Revelation 6:2” for the sixth seal (Revelation 6:12); the numbers are kept as captioned. He says Jacob when he means Isaac in the birthright story, and corrects himself. He says a solar eclipse lasts “7.4 seconds,” as captioned; total eclipses last up to about seven and a half minutes. He makes claims about science, history, health statistics, politics, other groups and moral behavior; these are his words and are not verified by this site. The transcript includes a description of sexual violence in a Middle East story (from about 54:00). “[Unclear]” marks six spots: about 5:30, 11:25, 12:00, 44:10, 46:40 and 50:00.

Now, they couldn’t do anything, but they could do this: go down the road, pull over to the side, shut the lights off, go back in the darkness around through the terrain to this shack where these soldiers lived, where they took their breaks, and sure enough they go there, they’ve got the daughter stripped naked, they’re molesting her, one of them’s in there molesting her, they go into that shed and they kill that soldier, they took his own gun and shot him cuz he was so involved in what he was doing he didn’t even notice him coming in, and then the two soldiers heard the shot and they come running in and they killed them too. Mom just laid them out. Why?

Cuz she wanted her daughter to live. They put their life on the line so that their children could live, and specifically this young teenage girl went back to the car and drove away, got to the refugee camp, and, folks, that’s what God wants. The humanist, he wants them to live, and he’ll do anything, and he’s trying to move you to speak to them, to share the gospel with them, share truth with them. He wants them to live, he wants them to have eternal life, he wants them to know him.

“Immediately after the tribulation of those days the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

“And there will be signs in the sun, in the moon, and in the stars; and on the earth distress of nations, with perplexity, the sea and the waves roaring; men’s hearts failing them from fear and the expectation of those things which are coming on the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

faqs.question: What are the two things God asks the Gentiles to do?
faqs.answer: He says “hear number one and heed number two.”

faqs.question: Does he believe there is life on other planets?
faqs.answer: No. He says “there is no life out there in space.”

faqs.question: What does he mean by “the army of the word”?
faqs.answer: He says an army we forget about “is the word,” used “to convince people” and that “it’s not always swords and spears.”

faqs.question: What does he say Psalm 9:19 wants the Gentiles to know?
faqs.answer: He says the prayer is to “put them in fear,” so that mankind knows “they’re just humans” and that God is “the supernatural God.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Arise, O LORD, Do not let man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Your sight. Put them in fear, O LORD, That the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah

faqs.question: What does he say the birthright is today?
faqs.answer: He says “birthright to us today is being born again, born of the word, born of the Spirit.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: lest there be any fornicator or profane person like Esau, who for one morsel of food sold his birthright. For you know that afterward, when he wanted to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for repentance, though he sought it diligently with tears.

faqs.question: What does he say the oil and light in the ten virgins mean?
faqs.answer: He says “the word is light, our right behavior is light,” and that the foolish virgins “had no word and they had no action to back up” it.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “Then the kingdom of heaven shall be likened to ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. Now five of them were wise, and five were foolish. Those who were foolish took their lamps and took no oil with them, but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps. But while the bridegroom was delayed, they all slumbered and slept. “And at midnight a cry was heard: ‘Behold, the bridegroom is coming; go out to meet him!’ Then all those virgins arose and trimmed their lamps. And the foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’ But the wise answered, saying, ‘No, lest there should not be enough for us and you; but go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’ And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding; and the door was shut. “Afterward the other virgins came also, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ But he answered and said, ‘Assuredly, I say to you, I do not know you.’ “Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

faqs.question: Who does he say Zion is?
faqs.answer: He says “Zion is the church, Zion is the people of God.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: For it is the day of the LORD’s vengeance, The year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

faqs.question: Does he say meteor showers fulfill the falling stars?
faqs.answer: No. He says “don’t mistake these meteor showers we have for the fulfillment of this verse.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: I looked when He opened the sixth seal, and behold, there was a great earthquake; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became like blood. And the stars of heaven fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its late figs when it is shaken by a mighty wind. Then the sky receded as a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

faqs.question: Does he say he has to prove the Bible is true to skeptics?
faqs.answer: No. He says “I don’t have to argue that the word of God is true,” and “I’m going to keep bringing you to the cross.”

faqs.question: How many times does he say the sun is darkened in the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says “it says three times in Revelation that the sun’s going to be darkened,” and that Old Testament prophets spoke of it “five times.”

faqs.question: What does he say are the two ways to get eternal life?
faqs.answer: He says the first is to “believe on Jesus, trust in him,” and the second is “keep the commandments,” and that preachers rarely teach it.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore He said: “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return. So he called ten of his servants, delivered to them ten minas, and said to them, ‘Do business till I come.’ But his citizens hated him, and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We will not have this man to reign over us.’

faqs.question: Where does he say Jesus is sitting now?
faqs.answer: He says “he sits on the throne now… ever since he ascended.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And the kings of the earth, the great men, the rich men, the commanders, the mighty men, every slave and every free man, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains, and said to the mountains and rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb! For the great day of His wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

faqs.question: Does he say Christians should hate their enemies?
faqs.answer: No. He says “we want to hate our enemies… no, no, God’s going to do things to get their attention so they can be delivered through Christ Jesus.”

faqs.question: What does he say God wants for those who reject him?
faqs.answer: He says “he wants them to live, he wants them to have eternal life, he wants them to know him.”
